A [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of '''[[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] creatures''' native to [[Nedij]] that were often eaten by the local [[Nediji]]. The Nediji found it amusing that these creatures so closely resembled many of the sentient species that the Nediji encountered offworld.
